# Samsung Galaxy Store
> Samsung Galaxy Store is Samsung’s app marketplace for Galaxy devices, offering apps, games, themes, and developer resources.

Samsung Galaxy Store serves both consumers discovering Galaxy apps and developers publishing, monetizing, and managing content for Samsung devices. The most useful LLM-oriented resources are Samsung Developer documentation, Galaxy Store seller guidance, API references, and support materials.

## Developer Portal
- [Samsung Developer](https://developer.samsung.com/): Main developer portal for Samsung platform documentation, tools, and program resources.
- [Galaxy Store](https://developer.samsung.com/galaxy-store): Overview of Galaxy Store development, publishing, and seller resources.
- [Seller Portal](https://seller.samsungapps.com/): Portal for managing Galaxy Store apps, submissions, and seller account operations.
- [Samsung Developers Blog](https://developer.samsung.com/blog): Articles, announcements, and technical updates for Samsung developers.
- [Support](https://developer.samsung.com/support): Developer support resources, contact options, and help materials.

## Galaxy Store Seller Documentation
- [Seller Portal Help](https://developer.samsung.com/galaxy-store/seller-portal): Documentation for using Seller Portal features and workflows.
- [App Registration Guide](https://developer.samsung.com/galaxy-store/seller-portal/app-registration.html): Steps and requirements for registering apps in Galaxy Store.
- [Binary Upload Guide](https://developer.samsung.com/galaxy-store/seller-portal/app-registration/binary-upload.html): Instructions for uploading app binaries during submission.
- [App Update Guide](https://developer.samsung.com/galaxy-store/seller-portal/app-update.html): Guidance for updating existing Galaxy Store applications.
- [Content Status](https://developer.samsung.com/galaxy-store/seller-portal/content-status.html): Explanation of app review and publication status states.
- [Statistics](https://developer.samsung.com/galaxy-store/seller-portal/statistics.html): Overview of sales and download statistics available to sellers.

## In-App Purchase
- [Samsung In-App Purchase](https://developer.samsung.com/iap): Overview of Samsung’s in-app purchase platform and integration resources.
- [IAP Programming Guide](https://developer.samsung.com/iap/programming-guide): Integration guide for implementing Samsung In-App Purchase in apps.
- [IAP API Reference](https://developer.samsung.com/iap/api-reference): Reference documentation for Samsung In-App Purchase APIs.
- [IAP Test Mode](https://developer.samsung.com/iap/programming-guide/test.html): Guidance for testing in-app purchases before production release.
- [Item Management](https://developer.samsung.com/iap/seller-office/item-management.html): Seller-side management of purchasable items and catalogs.
- [Subscription Management](https://developer.samsung.com/iap/seller-office/subscription.html): Documentation for configuring and managing subscription products.

## Galaxy Store Badges and Distribution
- [Galaxy Store Badge](https://developer.samsung.com/galaxy-store/badge): Official Galaxy Store badges and usage guidance for promotion.
- [Deep Linking](https://developer.samsung.com/galaxy-store/distribution/deep-linking.html): Methods for linking directly to Galaxy Store content pages.
- [Promotional Resources](https://developer.samsung.com/galaxy-store/marketing): Marketing assets and recommendations for Galaxy Store distribution.
- [Country Availability](https://developer.samsung.com/galaxy-store/distribution/country-availability.html): Information about regional distribution and availability settings.
- [Preload and Distribution](https://developer.samsung.com/galaxy-store/distribution): Distribution options and related Galaxy Store publishing information.

## Android App Development
- [Android](https://developer.samsung.com/android): Samsung-specific Android development resources and platform guidance.
- [Remote Test Lab](https://developer.samsung.com/remote-test-lab): Access to real Samsung devices for remote application testing.
- [Device Specifications](https://developer.samsung.com/devices): Hardware specifications and device information for Samsung products.
- [SDKs and Tools](https://developer.samsung.com/sdks): Samsung SDK downloads, tools, and integration resources.
- [Sample Code](https://developer.samsung.com/sample-code): Example projects and code samples for Samsung platforms.

## Galaxy Themes
- [Galaxy Themes](https://developer.samsung.com/galaxy-themes): Resources for designing, testing, and distributing Galaxy Themes content.
- [Themes Studio](https://developer.samsung.com/galaxy-themes/galaxy-themes-studio): Tooling for creating Samsung Galaxy Themes packages.
- [Themes Seller Office](https://developer.samsung.com/galaxy-themes/seller-office): Seller guidance for submitting and managing theme content.
- [Themes Design Guidelines](https://developer.samsung.com/galaxy-themes/design-guides): Design requirements and best practices for Galaxy Themes.
- [Themes FAQ](https://developer.samsung.com/galaxy-themes/faq): Frequently asked questions about Galaxy Themes development and submission.

## Watch and Wearable Development
- [Galaxy Watch](https://developer.samsung.com/galaxy-watch): Development resources for Galaxy Watch applications and watch faces.
- [Watch Face Studio](https://developer.samsung.com/watch-face-studio): Official tool for designing and building Wear OS watch faces.
- [Health Platform](https://developer.samsung.com/health): Samsung Health platform documentation and integration resources.
- [Accessory SDK](https://developer.samsung.com/accessory): SDK for communication between Samsung devices and accessories.
- [Tizen Archive](https://developer.samsung.com/tizen): Legacy Tizen development resources and documentation archive.

## Account, Policy, and Support
- [Seller Portal FAQ](https://seller.samsungapps.com/help/faq): Frequently asked questions for Galaxy Store sellers and account holders.
- [Seller Portal Notices](https://seller.samsungapps.com/help/notices): Official notices and operational updates for Seller Portal users.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://seller.samsungapps.com/help/termsAndConditions): Seller Portal terms, conditions, and legal agreements.
- [Privacy Policy](https://seller.samsungapps.com/help/privacyPolicy): Privacy policy governing Seller Portal and related services.
- [Contact Us](https://seller.samsungapps.com/help/contactUs): Support contact options for seller account and portal issues.

## News and Updates
- [Samsung Developers Blog](https://developer.samsung.com/blog): Technical blog posts, release notes, and ecosystem announcements.
- [Newsroom](https://news.samsung.com/global/): Corporate news and announcements from Samsung’s global newsroom.
- [Developer Events](https://developer.samsung.com/events): Information about Samsung developer events and sessions.
- [Forums](https://forum.developer.samsung.com/): Community discussions and troubleshooting for Samsung developers.
- [Release Notes](https://developer.samsung.com/release-notes): Updates and changes across Samsung developer tools and platforms.
